verses.textZh: 以下是对尼尼微的宣判，就是伊勒歌斯人那鸿的异象录。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是对尼尼微的宣判，就是伊勒歌斯人那鸿的异象录。
verses.textZhCuv: 论尼尼微的默示，就是伊勒歌斯人那鸿所得的默示。
verses.textEnNiv: A prophecy concerning Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
verses.textEnEsv: An oracle concerning Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum of Elkosh.
verses.textEnNkjv: The burden against Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
verses.textEnNlt: This message concerning Nineveh came as a vision to Nahum, who lived in Elkosh.
verses.textEnNasb: The pronouncement of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite:
verses.textEn: A prophecy concerning Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

verses.textZh: 耶和华是嫉恶和施行报复的神； 耶和华施行报复，并且满怀烈怒； 耶和华向他的对头施行报复， 向他的仇敌怀怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是嫉恶和施行报复的神； 耶和华施行报复，并且满怀烈怒； 耶和华向他的对头施行报复， 向他的仇敌怀怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是忌邪施报的神。 耶和华施报大有忿怒； 向他的敌人施报， 向他的仇敌怀怒。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is a jealous and avenging God; the Lord takes vengeance and is filled with wrath. The Lord takes vengeance on his foes and vents his wrath against his enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is a jealous and avenging God; the Lord is avenging and wrathful; the Lord takes vengeance on his adversaries and keeps wrath for his enemies.
verses.textEnNkjv: God is jealous, and the Lord avenges; The Lord avenges and is furious. The Lord will take vengeance on His adversaries, And He reserves wrath for His enemies;
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is a jealous God, filled with vengeance and rage. He takes revenge on all who oppose him and continues to rage against his enemies!
verses.textEnNasb: A jealous and avenging God is the Lord; The Lord is avenging and wrathful. The Lord takes vengeance on His adversaries, And He reserves wrath for His enemies.
verses.textEn: The Lord is a jealous and avenging God; the Lord takes vengeance and is filled with wrath. The Lord takes vengeance on his foes and vents his wrath against his enemies.

verses.textZh: 耶和华不轻易发怒，可是大有能力； 他绝不以有罪的为无罪。 耶和华乘着狂风暴雨而来， 云彩是他脚下的尘土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华不轻易发怒，可是大有能力； 他绝不以有罪的为无罪。 耶和华乘着狂风暴雨而来， 云彩是他脚下的尘土。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华不轻易发怒，大有能力， 万不以有罪的为无罪。 他乘旋风和暴风而来， 云彩为他脚下的尘土。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is slow to anger but great in power; the Lord will not leave the guilty unpunished. His way is in the whirlwind and the storm, and clouds are the dust of his feet.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is slow to anger and great in power, and the Lord will by no means clear the guilty. His way is in whirlwind and storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis slow to anger and great in power, And will not at all acquit thewicked. The Lord has His way In the whirlwind and in the storm, And the clouds are the dust of His feet.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is slow to get angry, but his power is great, and he never lets the guilty go unpunished. He displays his power in the whirlwind and the storm. The billowing clouds are the dust beneath his feet.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is slow to anger and great in power, And the Lord will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. In the gale and the storm is His way, And clouds are the dust beneath His feet.
verses.textEn: The Lord is slow to anger but great in power; the Lord will not leave the guilty unpunished. His way is in the whirlwind and the storm, and clouds are the dust of his feet.

verses.textZh: 他一斥责海，海就干了； 他使一切江河枯干。 巴珊和迦密的树林枯槁， 黎巴嫩的花卉凋残。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他一斥责海，海就干了； 他使一切江河枯干。 巴珊和迦密的树林枯槁， 黎巴嫩的花卉凋残。
verses.textZhCuv: 他斥责海，使海干了， 使一切江河干涸。 巴珊和迦密的树林衰残； 黎巴嫩的花草也衰残了。
verses.textEnNiv: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; he makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither and the blossoms of Lebanon fade.
verses.textEnEsv: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry; he dries up all the rivers; Bashan and Carmel wither; the bloom of Lebanon withers.
verses.textEnNkjv: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry, And dries up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel wither, And the flower of Lebanon wilts.
verses.textEnNlt: At his command the oceans dry up, and the rivers disappear. The lush pastures of Bashan and Carmel fade, and the green forests of Lebanon wither.
verses.textEnNasb: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; He dries up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel wither, The blossoms of Lebanon wither.
verses.textEn: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; he makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither and the blossoms of Lebanon fade.

verses.textZh: 大山在他面前震动， 小山也都融化； 大地在他面前废去， 世界和所有住在世上的，也都这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大山在他面前震动， 小山也都融化； 大地在他面前废去， 世界和所有住在世上的，也都这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 大山因他震动； 小山也都消化。 大地在他面前突起； 世界和住在其间的也都如此。
verses.textEnNiv: The mountains quake before him and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, the world and all who live in it.
verses.textEnEsv: The mountains quake before him; the hills melt; the earth heaves before him, the world and all who dwell in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: The mountains quake before Him, The hills melt, And the earth heaves at His presence, Yes, the world and all who dwell in it.
verses.textEnNlt: In his presence the mountains quake, and the hills melt away; the earth trembles, and its people are destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: Mountains quake because of Him, And the hills come apart; Indeed the earth is upheaved by His presence, The world and all the inhabitants in it.
verses.textEn: The mountains quake before him and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, the world and all who live in it.

verses.textZh: 在他盛怒之下，谁能站得住呢？ 他的烈怒谁能受得了呢？ 他的忿怒像火一般喷出来， 盘石在他面前都崩裂了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他盛怒之下，谁能站得住呢？ 他的烈怒谁能受得了呢？ 他的忿怒像火一般喷出来， 盘石在他面前都崩裂了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他发忿恨，谁能立得住呢？ 他发烈怒，谁能当得起呢？ 他的忿怒如火倾倒； 磐石因他崩裂。
verses.textEnNiv: Who can withstand his indignation? Who can endure his fierce anger? His wrath is poured out like fire; the rocks are shattered before him.
verses.textEnEsv: Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the heat of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken into pieces by him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who can stand before His indignation? And who can endure the fierceness of His anger? His fury is poured out like fire, And the rocks are thrown down by Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Who can stand before his fierce anger? Who can survive his burning fury? His rage blazes forth like fire, and the mountains crumble to dust in his presence.
verses.textEnNasb: Who can stand before His indignation? Who can endure the burning of His anger? His wrath gushes forth like fire, And the rocks are broken up by Him.
verses.textEn: Who can withstand his indignation? Who can endure his fierce anger? His wrath is poured out like fire; the rocks are shattered before him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华是良善的； 在患难的时候，他作人的避难所； 信靠他的人，他都认识。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是良善的； 在患难的时候，他作人的避难所； 信靠他的人，他都认识。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华本为善， 在患难的日子为人的保障， 并且认得那些投靠他的人。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is good, a refuge in times of trouble. He cares for those who trust in him,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; he knows those who take refuge in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis good, A stronghold in the day of trouble; And He knows those who trust in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is good, a strong refuge when trouble comes. He is close to those who trust in him.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is good, A stronghold in the day of trouble, And He knows those who take refuge in Him.
verses.textEn: The Lord is good, a refuge in times of trouble. He cares for those who trust in him,

verses.textZh: 但他必用泛滥的洪水， 尽行毁灭尼尼微之地， 把他的仇敌赶入黑暗之中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他必用泛滥的洪水， 尽行毁灭尼尼微之地， 把他的仇敌赶入黑暗之中。
verses.textZhCuv: 但他必以涨溢的洪水淹没尼尼微， 又驱逐仇敌进入黑暗。
verses.textEnNiv: but with an overwhelming flood he will make an end of Nineveh; he will pursue his foes into the realm of darkness.
verses.textEnEsv: But with an overflowing flood he will make a complete end of the adversaries, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: But with an overflowing flood He will make an utter end of its place, And darkness will pursue His enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: But he will sweep away his enemies in an overwhelming flood. He will pursue his foes into the darkness of night.
verses.textEnNasb: But with an overflowing flood He will make a complete end of its site, And will pursue His enemies into darkness.
verses.textEn: but with an overwhelming flood he will make an end of Nineveh; he will pursue his foes into the realm of darkness.

verses.textZh: 尼尼微人哪， 你们对耶和华还有甚么企图？ 他必尽行毁灭； 患难必不再次来临。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼尼微人哪， 你们对耶和华还有甚么企图？ 他必尽行毁灭； 患难必不再次来临。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼尼微人哪，设何谋攻击耶和华呢？ 他必将你们灭绝净尽； 灾难不再兴起。
verses.textEnNiv: Whatever they plot against the Lord he will bring to an end; trouble will not come a second time.
verses.textEnEsv: What do you plot against the Lord ? He will make a complete end; trouble will not rise up a second time.
verses.textEnNkjv: What do you conspire against the Lord? He will make an utter end ofit. Affliction will not rise up a second time.
verses.textEnNlt: Why are you scheming against the Lord ? He will destroy you with one blow; he won’t need to strike twice!
verses.textEnNasb: Whatever you devise against the Lord, He will make a complete end of it. Distress will not rise up twice.
verses.textEn: Whatever they plot against the Lord he will bring to an end; trouble will not come a second time.

verses.textZh: 他们像缠结着的荆棘， 像喝醉了的酒徒， 又像枯干的禾秸，全都被吞灭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们像缠结着的荆棘， 像喝醉了的酒徒， 又像枯干的禾秸，全都被吞灭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们像丛杂的荆棘， 像喝醉了的人， 又如枯干的碎秸全然烧灭。
verses.textEnNiv: They will be entangled among thorns and drunk from their wine; they will be consumed like dry stubble.
verses.textEnEsv: For they are like entangled thorns, like drunkards as they drink; they are consumed like stubble fully dried.
verses.textEnNkjv: For while tangled like thorns, And while drunken like drunkards, They shall be devoured like stubble fully dried.
verses.textEnNlt: His enemies, tangled like thornbushes and staggering like drunks, will be burned up like dry stubble in a field.
verses.textEnNasb: Like tangled thorns, And like those who are drunken with their drink, They are consumed Like stubble completely dried up.
verses.textEn: They will be entangled among thorns and drunk from their wine; they will be consumed like dry stubble.

verses.textZh: 有人从你那里出来， 就是筹划奸恶的人， 图谋恶事攻击耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人从你那里出来， 就是筹划奸恶的人， 图谋恶事攻击耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一人从你那里出来， 图谋邪恶，设恶计攻击耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: From you, Nineveh, has one come forth who plots evil against the Lord and devises wicked plans.
verses.textEnEsv: From you came one who plotted evil against the Lord , a worthless counselor.
verses.textEnNkjv: From you comes forth one Who plots evil against the Lord, A wicked counselor.
verses.textEnNlt: Who is this wicked counselor of yours who plots evil against the Lord ?
verses.textEnNasb: From you has gone out One who plotted evil against the Lord, A wicked counselor.
verses.textEn: From you, Nineveh, has one come forth who plots evil against the Lord and devises wicked plans.

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： 尼尼微人虽然装备完整， 人数众多， 他们仍必被剪除， 这样就完了。 我既然使你受过苦， 就一定不再叫你受苦了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： 尼尼微人虽然装备完整， 人数众多， 他们仍必被剪除， 这样就完了。 我既然使你受过苦， 就一定不再叫你受苦了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 尼尼微虽然势力充足，人数繁多， 也被剪除，归于无有。 犹大啊，我虽然使你受苦， 却不再使你受苦。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "Although they have allies and are numerous, they will be destroyed and pass away. Although I have afflicted you, Judah, I will afflict you no more.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord , "Though they are at full strength and many, they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "Though theyare safe, and likewise many, Yet in this manner they will be cut down When he passes through. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more;
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "Though the Assyrians have many allies, they will be destroyed and disappear. O my people, I have punished you before, but I will not punish you again.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "Though they are at full strength and so they are many, So also they will be cut off and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no longer.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "Although they have allies and are numerous, they will be destroyed and pass away. Although I have afflicted you, Judah, I will afflict you no more.

verses.textZh: 犹大啊！ 现在我必粉碎他在你身上的轭， 打断你的锁炼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大啊！ 现在我必粉碎他在你身上的轭， 打断你的锁炼。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我必从你颈项上折断他的轭， 扭开他的绳索。
verses.textEnNiv: Now I will break their yoke from your neck and tear your shackles away."
verses.textEnEsv: And now I will break his yoke from off you and will burst your bonds apart."
verses.textEnNkjv: For now I will break off his yoke from you, And burst your bonds apart."
verses.textEnNlt: Now I will break the yoke of bondage from your neck and tear off the chains of Assyrian oppression."
verses.textEnNasb: "So now, I will break his yoke from upon you, And I will tear your shackles to pieces."
verses.textEn: Now I will break their yoke from your neck and tear your shackles away."

verses.textZh: 尼尼微啊！ 耶和华已经向你下了命令： 你的名字必不再传于后世； 我必从你的神庙中， 除掉雕刻和铸造的偶像； 我必为你预备坟墓， 因为你没有存在的价值。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼尼微啊！ 耶和华已经向你下了命令： 你的名字必不再传于后世； 我必从你的神庙中， 除掉雕刻和铸造的偶像； 我必为你预备坟墓， 因为你没有存在的价值。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华已经出令，指着尼尼微说： 你名下的人必不留后； 我必从你神的庙中除灭雕刻的偶像和铸造的偶像； 我必因你鄙陋，使你归于坟墓。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has given a command concerning you, Nineveh: "You will have no descendants to bear your name. I will destroy the images and idols that are in the temple of your gods. I will prepare your grave, for you are vile."
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has given commandment about you: "No more shall your name be perpetuated; from the house of your gods I will cut off the carved image and the metal image. I will make your grave, for you are vile."
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has given a command concerning you: "Your name shall be perpetuated no longer. Out of the house of your gods I will cut off the carved image and the molded image. I will dig your grave, For you are vile."
verses.textEnNlt: And this is what the Lord says concerning the Assyrians in Nineveh: "You will have no more children to carry on your name. I will destroy all the idols in the temples of your gods. I am preparing a grave for you because you are despicable!"
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has issued a command concerning you: " Your name will no longer be perpetuated. I will eliminate the carved image and the cast metal image From the house of your gods. I will prepare your grave, For you are contemptible."
verses.textEn: The Lord has given a command concerning you, Nineveh: "You will have no descendants to bear your name. I will destroy the images and idols that are in the temple of your gods. I will prepare your grave, for you are vile."

verses.textZh: 看哪！那传报佳音、宣告和平之人的脚， 已经站在山上，说： 犹大啊！守你的节期， 还你的愿吧！ 因为那奸恶的人永不会再从你中间经过； 他已被彻底除灭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！那传报佳音、宣告和平之人的脚， 已经站在山上，说： 犹大啊！守你的节期， 还你的愿吧！ 因为那奸恶的人永不会再从你中间经过； 他已被彻底除灭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，有报好信传平安之人的脚登山，说： 犹大啊，可以守你的节期， 还你所许的愿吧！ 因为那恶人不再从你中间经过， 他已灭绝净尽了。
verses.textEnNiv: Look, there on the mountains, the feet of one who brings good news, who proclaims peace! Celebrate your festivals, Judah, and fulfill your vows. No more will the wicked invade you; they will be completely destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, upon the mountains, the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace! Keep your feasts, O Judah; fulfill your vows, for never again shall the worthless pass through you; he is utterly cut off.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, on the mountains The feet of him who brings good tidings, Who proclaims peace! O Judah, keep your appointed feasts, Perform your vows. For the wicked one shall no more pass through you; He is utterly cut off.
verses.textEnNlt: Look! A messenger is coming over the mountains with good news! He is bringing a message of peace. Celebrate your festivals, O people of Judah, and fulfill all your vows, for your wicked enemies will never invade your land again. They will be completely destroyed!
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, on the mountains, the feet of him who brings good news, Who announces peace! Celebrate your feasts, Judah, Pay your vows. For never again will the wicked one pass through you; He is eliminated completely.
verses.textEn: Look, there on the mountains, the feet of one who brings good news, who proclaims peace! Celebrate your festivals, Judah, and fulfill your vows. No more will the wicked invade you; they will be completely destroyed.

verses.textZh: 尼尼微啊！ 那分散邦国的必上来攻击你， 你要固守堡垒， 严防要道，束紧你的腰， 大大增强你的力量。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼尼微啊！ 那分散邦国的必上来攻击你， 你要固守堡垒， 严防要道，束紧你的腰， 大大增强你的力量。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼尼微啊，那打碎邦国的上来攻击你。 你要看守保障，谨防道路， 使腰强壮，大大勉力。 （
verses.textEnNiv: An attacker advances against you, Nineveh. Guard the fortress, watch the road, brace yourselves, marshal all your strength!
verses.textEnEsv: The scatterer has come up against you. Man the ramparts; watch the road; dress for battle; collect all your strength.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who scatters has come up before your face. Man the fort! Watch the road! Strengthen your flanks! Fortify your power mightily.
verses.textEnNlt: Your enemy is coming to crush you, Nineveh. Man the ramparts! Watch the roads! Prepare your defenses! Call out your forces!
verses.textEnNasb: The one who scatters has come up against you. Keep watch over the fortress, watch the road; Bind up your waist, summon all your strength.
verses.textEn: An attacker advances against you, Nineveh. Guard the fortress, watch the road, brace yourselves, marshal all your strength!

verses.textZh: 然而，耶和华必恢复雅各的光荣， 好象以色列的光荣一样； 因为劫掠的人曾把他们劫掠一空， 又把他们的葡萄枝子毁坏了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，耶和华必恢复雅各的光荣， 好象以色列的光荣一样； 因为劫掠的人曾把他们劫掠一空， 又把他们的葡萄枝子毁坏了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华复兴雅各的荣华， 好像以色列的荣华一样； 因为使地空虚的， 已经使雅各和以色列空虚， 将他们的葡萄枝毁坏了。）
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will restore the splendor of Jacob like the splendor of Israel, though destroyers have laid them waste and have ruined their vines.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord is restoring the majesty of Jacob as the majesty of Israel, for plunderers have plundered them and ruined their branches.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord will restore the excellence of Jacob Like the excellence of Israel, For the emptiers have emptied them out And ruined their vine branches.
verses.textEnNlt: Even though the destroyer has destroyed Judah, the Lord will restore its honor. Israel’s vine has been stripped of branches, but he will restore its splendor.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord will restore the splendor of Jacob Like the splendor of Israel, Even though destroyers have laid waste to them And ruined their vines.
verses.textEn: The Lord will restore the splendor of Jacob like the splendor of Israel, though destroyers have laid them waste and have ruined their vines.

verses.textZh: 他勇士的盾牌是红的， 战士的衣服是朱红的。 在他预备出击的时候， 战车的钢铁闪烁如火， 骑兵 疾驰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他勇士的盾牌是红的， 战士的衣服是朱红的。 在他预备出击的时候， 战车的钢铁闪烁如火， 骑兵 疾驰。
verses.textZhCuv: 他勇士的盾牌是红的， 精兵都穿朱红衣服。 在他预备争战的日子， 战车上的钢铁闪烁如火， 柏木把的枪也抡起来了。
verses.textEnNiv: The shields of the soldiers are red; the warriors are clad in scarlet. The metal on the chariots flashes on the day they are made ready; the spears of juniper are brandished.
verses.textEnEsv: The shield of his mighty men is red; his soldiers are clothed in scarlet. The chariots come with flashing metal on the day he musters them; the cypress spears are brandished.
verses.textEnNkjv: The shields of his mighty men are made red, The valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots come with flaming torches In the day of his preparation, And the spears are brandished.
verses.textEnNlt: Shields flash red in the sunlight! See the scarlet uniforms of the valiant troops! Watch as their glittering chariots move into position, with a forest of spears waving above them.
verses.textEnNasb: The shields of his warriors are dyed red, The warriors are dressed in scarlet, The chariots are fitted with flashing steel When he is prepared to march, And the juniper spears are brandished.
verses.textEn: The shields of the soldiers are red; the warriors are clad in scarlet. The metal on the chariots flashes on the day they are made ready; the spears of juniper are brandished.

verses.textZh: 战车在街上狂奔， 在广场上东奔西驰； 它们看起来像火把， 跑起来像闪电。
verses.textZhCnvs: 战车在街上狂奔， 在广场上东奔西驰； 它们看起来像火把， 跑起来像闪电。
verses.textZhCuv: 车辆在街上 急行， 在宽阔处奔来奔去， 形状如火把， 飞跑如闪电。
verses.textEnNiv: The chariots storm through the streets, rushing back and forth through the squares. They look like flaming torches; they dart about like lightning.
verses.textEnEsv: The chariots race madly through the streets; they rush to and fro through the squares; they gleam like torches; they dart like lightning.
verses.textEnNkjv: The chariots rage in the streets, They jostle one another in the broad roads; They seem like torches, They run like lightning.
verses.textEnNlt: The chariots race recklessly along the streets and rush wildly through the squares. They flash like firelight and move as swiftly as lightning.
verses.textEnNasb: The chariots drive wildly in the streets, They rush around in the public squares; Their appearance is like torches, They drive back and forth like lightning flashes.
verses.textEn: The chariots storm through the streets, rushing back and forth through the squares. They look like flaming torches; they dart about like lightning.

verses.textZh: 亚述王召集他的权臣， 他们跌跌撞撞而来， 急急忙忙走上城墙， 竖起了防御的挡牌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述王召集他的权臣， 他们跌跌撞撞而来， 急急忙忙走上城墙， 竖起了防御的挡牌。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼尼微王招聚他的贵胄； 他们步行绊跌， 速上城墙，预备挡牌。
verses.textEnNiv: Nineveh summons her picked troops, yet they stumble on their way. They dash to the city wall; the protective shield is put in place.
verses.textEnEsv: He remembers his officers; they stumble as they go, they hasten to the wall; the siege tower is set up.
verses.textEnNkjv: He remembers his nobles; They stumble in their walk; They make haste to her walls, And the defense is prepared.
verses.textEnNlt: The king shouts to his officers; they stumble in their haste, rushing to the walls to set up their defenses.
verses.textEnNasb: He remembers his officers; They stumble in their advance, They hurry to her wall, And the mantelet is set up.
verses.textEn: Nineveh summons her picked troops, yet they stumble on their way. They dash to the city wall; the protective shield is put in place.

verses.textZh: 河闸都被打开， 宫殿也给摧毁了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 河闸都被打开， 宫殿也给摧毁了。
verses.textZhCuv: 河闸开放，宫殿冲没。
verses.textEnNiv: The river gates are thrown open and the palace collapses.
verses.textEnEsv: The river gates are opened; the palace melts away;
verses.textEnNkjv: The gates of the rivers are opened, And the palace is dissolved.
verses.textEnNlt: The river gates have been torn open! The palace is about to collapse!
verses.textEnNasb: The gates of the rivers are opened And the palace sways back and forth.
verses.textEn: The river gates are thrown open and the palace collapses.

verses.textZh: 王后赤身被掳去； 她的宫女都哀哭， 声如鸽子， 各人搥胸痛哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王后赤身被掳去； 她的宫女都哀哭， 声如鸽子， 各人搥胸痛哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 王后蒙羞，被人掳去； 宫女捶胸，哀鸣如鸽。 此乃命定之事。
verses.textEnNiv: It is decreed that Nineveh be exiled and carried away. Her female slaves moan like doves and beat on their breasts.
verses.textEnEsv: its mistress is stripped; she is carried off, her slave girls lamenting, moaning like doves and beating their breasts.
verses.textEnNkjv: It is decreed: She shall be led away captive, She shall be brought up; And her maidservants shall lead her as with the voice of doves, Beating their breasts.
verses.textEnNlt: Nineveh’s exile has been decreed, and all the servant girls mourn its capture. They moan like doves and beat their breasts in sorrow.
verses.textEnNasb: It is set: She is stripped, she is led away, And her slave women are sobbing like the sound of doves, Beating their breasts.
verses.textEn: It is decreed that Nineveh be exiled and carried away. Her female slaves moan like doves and beat on their breasts.

verses.textZh: 自古以来，尼尼微一直都像个聚水的池， 但现在居民却不断溃逃 ； 虽然有人呼叫："止住！止住！" 却没有回转的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 自古以来，尼尼微一直都像个聚水的池， 但现在居民却不断溃逃 ； 虽然有人呼叫："止住！止住！" 却没有回转的。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼尼微自古以来充满人民， 如同聚水的池子； 现在居民却都逃跑。 虽有人呼喊说：站住！站住！ 却无人回顾。
verses.textEnNiv: Nineveh is like a pool whose water is draining away. "Stop! Stop!" they cry, but no one turns back.
verses.textEnEsv: Nineveh is like a pool whose waters run away. "Halt! Halt!" they cry, but none turns back.
verses.textEnNkjv: Though Nineveh of old was like a pool of water, Now they flee away. "Halt! Halt!" theycry; But no one turns back.
verses.textEnNlt: Nineveh is like a leaking water reservoir! The people are slipping away. "Stop, stop!" someone shouts, but no one even looks back.
verses.textEnNasb: Though Nineveh was like a pool of water throughout her days, Yet they are fleeing; "Stop, stop," But no one turns back.
verses.textEn: Nineveh is like a pool whose water is draining away. "Stop! Stop!" they cry, but no one turns back.

verses.textZh: 你们劫掠银子，抢夺金子吧！ 积蓄的财宝无穷无尽， 珍贵的器皿不可胜数。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们劫掠银子，抢夺金子吧！ 积蓄的财宝无穷无尽， 珍贵的器皿不可胜数。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们抢掠金银吧！ 因为所积蓄的无穷， 华美的宝器无数。
verses.textEnNiv: Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold! The supply is endless, the wealth from all its treasures!
verses.textEnEsv: Plunder the silver, plunder the gold! There is no end of the treasure or of the wealth of all precious things.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take spoil of silver! Take spoil of gold! Thereis no end of treasure, Or wealth of every desirable prize.
verses.textEnNlt: Loot the silver! Plunder the gold! There’s no end to Nineveh’s treasures— its vast, uncounted wealth.
verses.textEnNasb: Plunder the silver, Plunder the gold! For there is no end to the treasure— Wealth from every kind of desirable object.
verses.textEn: Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold! The supply is endless, the wealth from all its treasures!

verses.textZh: 现在却空虚、荒凉，一无所有； 人心惊惶，两膝发抖， 全身疼痛， 面无血色。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在却空虚、荒凉，一无所有； 人心惊惶，两膝发抖， 全身疼痛， 面无血色。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼尼微现在空虚荒凉， 人心消化，双膝相碰， 腰都疼痛，脸都变色。
verses.textEnNiv: She is pillaged, plundered, stripped! Hearts melt, knees give way, bodies tremble, every face grows pale.
verses.textEnEsv: Desolate! Desolation and ruin! Hearts melt and knees tremble; anguish is in all loins; all faces grow pale!
verses.textEnNkjv: She is empty, desolate, and waste! The heart melts, and the knees shake; Much pain is in every side, And all their faces are drained of color.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon the city is plundered, empty, and ruined. Hearts melt and knees shake. The people stand aghast, their faces pale and trembling.
verses.textEnNasb: She is emptied! Yes, she is desolate and waste! Hearts are melting and knees wobbling! Also trembling is in the entire body, And all their faces have become pale!
verses.textEn: She is pillaged, plundered, stripped! Hearts melt, knees give way, bodies tremble, every face grows pale.

verses.textZh: 狮子的洞穴在哪里？ 喂养幼狮的地方在哪里？ 公狮、母狮和幼狮不受惊吓之处，可以闲游的地方又在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 狮子的洞穴在哪里？ 喂养幼狮的地方在哪里？ 公狮、母狮和幼狮不受惊吓之处，可以闲游的地方又在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 狮子的洞和少壮狮子喂养之处在哪里呢？ 公狮母狮小狮游行、无人惊吓之地在哪里呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Where now is the lions’ den, the place where they fed their young, where the lion and lioness went, and the cubs, with nothing to fear?
verses.textEnEsv: Where is the lions’ den, the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion and lioness went, where his cubs were, with none to disturb?
verses.textEnNkjv: Where is the dwelling of the lions, And the feeding place of the young lions, Where the lion walked, the lioness and lion’s cub, And no one made them afraid?
verses.textEnNlt: Where now is that great Nineveh, that den filled with young lions? It was a place where people—like lions and their cubs— walked freely and without fear.
verses.textEnNasb: Where is the den of the lions And the feeding place of the young lions, Where the lion, lioness, and lion’s cub went With nothing to disturb them?
verses.textEn: Where now is the lions’ den, the place where they fed their young, where the lion and lioness went, and the cubs, with nothing to fear?

verses.textZh: 公狮为幼狮撕碎足够的食物， 为母狮掐死活物； 把猎物塞满了牠的洞， 把撕碎的填满了牠的穴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 公狮为幼狮撕碎足够的食物， 为母狮掐死活物； 把猎物塞满了牠的洞， 把撕碎的填满了牠的穴。
verses.textZhCuv: 公狮为小狮撕碎许多食物， 为母狮掐死活物， 把撕碎的、掐死的充满它的洞穴。
verses.textEnNiv: The lion killed enough for his cubs and strangled the prey for his mate, filling his lairs with the kill and his dens with the prey.
verses.textEnEsv: The lion tore enough for his cubs and strangled prey for his lionesses; he filled his caves with prey and his dens with torn flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, Killed for his lionesses, Filled his caves with prey, And his dens with flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: The lion tore up meat for his cubs and strangled prey for his mate. He filled his den with prey, his caverns with his plunder.
verses.textEnNasb: The lion tore enough for his cubs, Killed enough prey for his lionesses, And filled his lairs with prey And his dens with torn flesh.
verses.textEn: The lion killed enough for his cubs and strangled the prey for his mate, filling his lairs with the kill and his dens with the prey.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华说： 看哪！我必攻击你， 我要把你的 战车焚烧成烟， 刀剑必吞灭你的幼狮； 我必从地上除去你的猎物， 你使者的声音也必不再有人听见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华说： 看哪！我必攻击你， 我要把你的 战车焚烧成烟， 刀剑必吞灭你的幼狮； 我必从地上除去你的猎物， 你使者的声音也必不再有人听见。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华说：「我与你为敌，必将你的车辆焚烧成烟，刀剑也必吞灭你的少壮狮子。我必从地上除灭你所撕碎的，你使者的声音必不再听见。」
verses.textEnNiv: "I am against you," declares the Lord Almighty. "I will burn up your chariots in smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions. I will leave you no prey on the earth. The voices of your messengers will no longer be heard."
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I am against you, declares the Lord of hosts, and I will burn your chariots in smoke, and the sword shall devour your young lions. I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers shall no longer be heard.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I am against you," says the Lord of hosts, "I will burn your chariots in smoke, and the sword shall devour your young lions; I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers shall be heard no more."
verses.textEnNlt: "I am your enemy!" says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies. "Your chariots will soon go up in smoke. Your young men will be killed in battle. Never again will you plunder conquered nations. The voices of your proud messengers will be heard no more."
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I am against you," declares the Lord of armies. "I will burn up her chariots in smoke, and a sword will devour your young lions; I will eliminate your prey from the land, and no longer will the voice of your messengers be heard."
verses.textEn: "I am against you," declares the Lord Almighty. "I will burn up your chariots in smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions. I will leave you no prey on the earth. The voices of your messengers will no longer be heard."

verses.textZh: 这流人血的城，有祸了！ 全城欺诈， 充满劫掠； 抢夺的事总不止息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这流人血的城，有祸了！ 全城欺诈， 充满劫掠； 抢夺的事总不止息。
verses.textZhCuv: 祸哉！这流人血的城， 充满谎诈和强暴－ 抢夺的事总不止息。
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to the city of blood, full of lies, full of plunder, never without victims!
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to the bloody city, all full of lies and plunder— no end to the prey!
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery. Its victim never departs.
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow awaits Nineveh, the city of murder and lies! She is crammed with wealth and is never without victims.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to the bloody city, completely full of lies and pillage; Her prey does not leave.
verses.textEn: Woe to the city of blood, full of lies, full of plunder, never without victims!

verses.textZh: 鞭声飕飕， 轮声辚辚， 骏马奔驰， 战车颠簸跳动。
verses.textZhCnvs: 鞭声飕飕， 轮声辚辚， 骏马奔驰， 战车颠簸跳动。
verses.textZhCuv: 鞭声响亮，车轮轰轰， 马匹踢跳，车辆奔腾，
verses.textEnNiv: The crack of whips, the clatter of wheels, galloping horses and jolting chariots!
verses.textEnEsv: The crack of the whip, and rumble of the wheel, galloping horse and bounding chariot!
verses.textEnNkjv: The noise of a whip And the noise of rattling wheels, Of galloping horses, Of clattering chariots!
verses.textEnNlt: Hear the crack of whips, the rumble of wheels! Horses’ hooves pound, and chariots clatter wildly.
verses.textEnNasb: The sound of the whip, The sound of the roar of the wheel, Galloping horses And bounding chariots!
verses.textEn: The crack of whips, the clatter of wheels, galloping horses and jolting chariots!

verses.textZh: 骑兵腾跃冲锋； 刀剑烁烁发亮， 枪矛闪闪生光； 被杀的人众多， 死尸成堆； 尸体无数， 众人都被尸体绊倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 骑兵腾跃冲锋； 刀剑烁烁发亮， 枪矛闪闪生光； 被杀的人众多， 死尸成堆； 尸体无数， 众人都被尸体绊倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 马兵争先，刀剑发光， 枪矛闪烁，被杀的甚多， 尸首成了大堆， 尸骸无数，人碰着而跌倒，
verses.textEnNiv: Charging cavalry, flashing swords and glittering spears! Many casualties, piles of dead, bodies without number, people stumbling over the corpses—
verses.textEnEsv: Horsemen charging, flashing sword and glittering spear, hosts of slain, heaps of corpses, dead bodies without end— they stumble over the bodies!
verses.textEnNkjv: Horsemen charge with bright sword and glittering spear. Thereis a multitude of slain, A great number of bodies, Countless corpses— They stumble over the corpses—
verses.textEnNlt: See the flashing swords and glittering spears as the charioteers charge past! There are countless casualties, heaps of bodies— so many bodies that people stumble over them.
verses.textEnNasb: Horsemen charging, Swords flashing, spears gleaming, Many killed, a mass of corpses, And there is no end to the dead bodies— They stumble over the dead bodies!
verses.textEn: Charging cavalry, flashing swords and glittering spears! Many casualties, piles of dead, bodies without number, people stumbling over the corpses—

verses.textZh: 都因妓女多有淫行， 施邪术的美丽女巫， 借着她的淫行诱惑列国， 借着她的邪术欺骗万族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 都因妓女多有淫行， 施邪术的美丽女巫， 借着她的淫行诱惑列国， 借着她的邪术欺骗万族。
verses.textZhCuv: 都因那美貌的妓女多有淫行， 惯行邪术，藉淫行诱惑列国， 用邪术诱惑 多族。
verses.textEnNiv: all because of the wanton lust of a prostitute, alluring, the mistress of sorceries, who enslaved nations by her prostitution and peoples by her witchcraft.
verses.textEnEsv: And all for the countless whorings of the prostitute, graceful and of deadly charms, who betrays nations with her whorings, and peoples with her charms.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because of the multitude of harlotries of the seductive harlot, The mistress of sorceries, Who sells nations through her harlotries, And families through her sorceries.
verses.textEnNlt: All this because Nineveh, the beautiful and faithless city, mistress of deadly charms, enticed the nations with her beauty. She taught them all her magic, enchanting people everywhere.
verses.textEnNasb: All because of the many sexual acts of the prostitute, The charming one, the mistress of sorceries, Who sells nations by her sexual acts, And families by her sorceries.
verses.textEn: all because of the wanton lust of a prostitute, alluring, the mistress of sorceries, who enslaved nations by her prostitution and peoples by her witchcraft.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华说： 看哪！我必攻击你； 我要把你的裙子掀到你的脸上， 使万国看见你赤身露体， 使列邦看见你的羞耻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华说： 看哪！我必攻击你； 我要把你的裙子掀到你的脸上， 使万国看见你赤身露体， 使列邦看见你的羞耻。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华说：我与你为敌； 我必揭起你的衣襟，蒙在你脸上， 使列国看见你的赤体， 使列邦观看你的丑陋。
verses.textEnNiv: "I am against you," declares the Lord Almighty. "I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness and the kingdoms your shame.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I am against you, declares the Lord of hosts, and will lift up your skirts over your face; and I will make nations look at your nakedness and kingdoms at your shame.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I am against you," says the Lord of hosts; "I will lift your skirts over your face, I will show the nations your nakedness, And the kingdoms your shame.
verses.textEnNlt: "I am your enemy!" says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies. "And now I will lift your skirts and show all the earth your nakedness and shame.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I am against you," declares the Lord of armies; "And I will lift up your skirts over your face, And show the nations your nakedness, And the kingdoms your shame.
verses.textEn: "I am against you," declares the Lord Almighty. "I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness and the kingdoms your shame.

verses.textZh: 我要把污秽可憎之物拋在你身上， 侮辱你，使你成为众人观看的对象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把污秽可憎之物拋在你身上， 侮辱你，使你成为众人观看的对象。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将可憎污秽之物抛在你身上， 辱没你，为众目所观。
verses.textEnNiv: I will pelt you with filth, I will treat you with contempt and make you a spectacle.
verses.textEnEsv: I will throw filth at you and treat you with contempt and make you a spectacle.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will cast abominable filth upon you, Make you vile, And make you a spectacle.
verses.textEnNlt: I will cover you with filth and show the world how vile you really are.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will throw filth on you And declare you worthless, And set you up as a spectacle.
verses.textEn: I will pelt you with filth, I will treat you with contempt and make you a spectacle.

verses.textZh: 看见你的都必逃避你，说： "尼尼微荒凉了； 有谁为她悲哀呢？" 我在哪里可以找到安慰你的人呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 看见你的都必逃避你，说： "尼尼微荒凉了； 有谁为她悲哀呢？" 我在哪里可以找到安慰你的人呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 凡看见你的，都必逃跑离开你， 说：尼尼微荒凉了！有谁为你悲伤呢？ 我何处寻得安慰你的人呢？
verses.textEnNiv: All who see you will flee from you and say, ‘Nineveh is in ruins—who will mourn for her?’ Where can I find anyone to comfort you?"
verses.textEnEsv: And all who look at you will shrink from you and say, "Wasted is Nineveh; who will grieve for her?" Where shall I seek comforters for you?
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall come to pass that all who look upon you Will flee from you, and say, ‘Nineveh is laid waste! Who will bemoan her?’ Where shall I seek comforters for you?"
verses.textEnNlt: All who see you will shrink back and say, ‘Nineveh lies in ruins. Where are the mourners?’ Does anyone regret your destruction?"
verses.textEnNasb: "And it will come about that all who see you Will shrink from you and say, ‘Nineveh is devastated! Who will have sympathy for her?’ Where shall I seek comforters for you?"
verses.textEn: All who see you will flee from you and say, ‘Nineveh is in ruins—who will mourn for her?’ Where can I find anyone to comfort you?"

verses.textZh: 你比挪亚们还强吗？ 挪亚们位于尼罗河流域， 周围有水环绕； 海是她的屏障， 水作她的墙垣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你比挪亚们还强吗？ 挪亚们位于尼罗河流域， 周围有水环绕； 海是她的屏障， 水作她的墙垣。
verses.textZhCuv: 你岂比挪亚们强呢？ 挪亚们坐落在众河之间，周围有水； 海 作她的濠沟， 又作她的城墙。
verses.textEnNiv: Are you better than Thebes, situated on the Nile, with water around her? The river was her defense, the waters her wall.
verses.textEnEsv: Are you better than Thebes that sat by the Nile, with water around her, her rampart a sea, and water her wall?
verses.textEnNkjv: Are you better than No Amon Thatwas situated by the River, That had the waters around her, Whose rampart was the sea, Whose wall was the sea?
verses.textEnNlt: Are you any better than the city of Thebes, situated on the Nile River, surrounded by water? She was protected by the river on all sides, walled in by water.
verses.textEnNasb: Are you better than No-amon, Which was situated by the canals of the Nile, With water surrounding her, Whose rampart was the sea, Whose wall consisted of the sea?
verses.textEn: Are you better than Thebes, situated on the Nile, with water around her? The river was her defense, the waters her wall.

verses.textZh: 古实和埃及，是她无穷的力量， 弗人和路比族，是她的 助手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 古实和埃及，是她无穷的力量， 弗人和路比族，是她的 助手。
verses.textZhCuv: 古实和埃及是她无穷的力量； 弗人和路比族是她的帮手。
verses.textEnNiv: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength; Put and Libya were among her allies.
verses.textEnEsv: Cush was her strength; Egypt too, and that without limit; Put and the Libyans were her helpers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, And itwas boundless; Put and Lubim were your helpers.
verses.textEnNlt: Ethiopia and the land of Egypt gave unlimited assistance. The nations of Put and Libya were among her allies.
verses.textEnNasb: Ethiopia was her might, Egypt too, without limits. Put and Lubim were among her helpers.
verses.textEn: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength; Put and Libya were among her allies.

verses.textZh: 然而她却被迁徙， 被掳去了； 她的婴孩在各街头被摔死； 人们为她的尊贵人抽签。 她所有的达官贵人都被锁炼捆着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而她却被迁徙， 被掳去了； 她的婴孩在各街头被摔死； 人们为她的尊贵人抽签。 她所有的达官贵人都被锁炼捆着。
verses.textZhCuv: 但她被迁移，被掳去； 她的婴孩在各市口上也被摔死。 人为她的尊贵人拈阄； 她所有的大人都被链子锁着。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet she was taken captive and went into exile. Her infants were dashed to pieces at every street corner. Lots were cast for her nobles, and all her great men were put in chains.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet she became an exile; she went into captivity; her infants were dashed in pieces at the head of every street; for her honored men lots were cast, and all her great men were bound in chains.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet she was carried away, She went into captivity; Her young children also were dashed to pieces At the head of every street; They cast lots for her honorable men, And all her great men were bound in chains.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet Thebes fell, and her people were led away as captives. Her babies were dashed to death against the stones of the streets. Soldiers threw dice to get Egyptian officers as servants. All their leaders were bound in chains.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet she became an exile, She went into captivity; Also her small children were smashed to pieces At the head of every street; They cast lots for her honorable men, And all her great men were bound with shackles.
verses.textEn: Yet she was taken captive and went into exile. Her infants were dashed to pieces at every street corner. Lots were cast for her nobles, and all her great men were put in chains.

verses.textZh: 至于你，你必喝醉， 必被隐藏； 你必因仇敌的缘故， 寻找避难所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你，你必喝醉， 必被隐藏； 你必因仇敌的缘故， 寻找避难所。
verses.textZhCuv: 你也必喝醉，必被埋藏， 并因仇敌的缘故寻求避难所。
verses.textEnNiv: You too will become drunk; you will go into hiding and seek refuge from the enemy.
verses.textEnEsv: You also will be drunken; you will go into hiding; you will seek a refuge from the enemy.
verses.textEnNkjv: You also will be drunk; You will be hidden; You also will seek refuge from the enemy.
verses.textEnNlt: And you, Nineveh, will also stagger like a drunkard. You will hide for fear of the attacking enemy.
verses.textEnNasb: You too will become drunk, You will be hidden. You too will search for a refuge from the enemy.
verses.textEn: You too will become drunk; you will go into hiding and seek refuge from the enemy.

verses.textZh: 你一切堡垒，如同无花果树上初熟的果子， 若被摇撼， 就必落在想吃的人口中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你一切堡垒，如同无花果树上初熟的果子， 若被摇撼， 就必落在想吃的人口中。
verses.textZhCuv: 你一切保障必像无花果树上初熟的无花果， 若一摇撼就落在想吃之人的口中。
verses.textEnNiv: All your fortresses are like fig trees with their first ripe fruit; when they are shaken, the figs fall into the mouth of the eater.
verses.textEnEsv: All your fortresses are like fig trees with first-ripe figs— if shaken they fall into the mouth of the eater.
verses.textEnNkjv: All your strongholds are fig trees with ripened figs: If they are shaken, They fall into the mouth of the eater.
verses.textEnNlt: All your fortresses will fall. They will be devoured like the ripe figs that fall into the mouths of those who shake the trees.
verses.textEnNasb: All your fortifications are fig trees with ripe fruit— When shaken, they fall into the eater’s mouth.
verses.textEn: All your fortresses are like fig trees with their first ripe fruit; when they are shaken, the figs fall into the mouth of the eater.

verses.textZh: 看哪！在你里面的人都是妇女， 你境内的门户， 都向仇敌敞开； 你的门闩被火烧毁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！在你里面的人都是妇女， 你境内的门户， 都向仇敌敞开； 你的门闩被火烧毁。
verses.textZhCuv: 你地上的人民如同妇女； 你国中的关口向仇敌敞开； 你的门闩被火焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: Look at your troops— they are all weaklings. The gates of your land are wide open to your enemies; fire has consumed the bars of your gates.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, your troops are women in your midst. The gates of your land are wide open to your enemies; fire has devoured your bars.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely, your people in your midst are women! The gates of your land are wide open for your enemies; Fire shall devour the bars of your gates.
verses.textEnNlt: Your troops will be as weak and helpless as women. The gates of your land will be opened wide to the enemy and set on fire and burned.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, your people are women in your midst! The gates of your land are opened wide to your enemies; Fire consumes your gate bars.
verses.textEn: Look at your troops— they are all weaklings. The gates of your land are wide open to your enemies; fire has consumed the bars of your gates.

verses.textZh: 你要打水，以备围困， 巩固你的堡垒， 踹泥踏土， 紧握砖模。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要打水，以备围困， 巩固你的堡垒， 踹泥踏土， 紧握砖模。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要打水预备受困； 要坚固你的保障， 踹土和泥，修补砖窑。
verses.textEnNiv: Draw water for the siege, strengthen your defenses! Work the clay, tread the mortar, repair the brickwork!
verses.textEnEsv: Draw water for the siege; strengthen your forts; go into the clay; tread the mortar; take hold of the brick mold!
verses.textEnNkjv: Draw your water for the siege! Fortify your strongholds! Go into the clay and tread the mortar! Make strong the brick kiln!
verses.textEnNlt: Get ready for the siege! Store up water! Strengthen the defenses! Go into the pits to trample clay, and pack it into molds, making bricks to repair the walls.
verses.textEnNasb: Draw for yourself water for a siege! Strengthen your fortifications! Go into the clay and tread the mortar! Take hold of the brick mold!
verses.textEn: Draw water for the siege, strengthen your defenses! Work the clay, tread the mortar, repair the brickwork!

verses.textZh: 在那里火要烧灭你， 刀剑要除灭你， 吞吃你，好象吞吃蚱蜢一样， 你只管增多如蚱蜢， 加添像蝗虫，
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里火要烧灭你， 刀剑要除灭你， 吞吃你，好象吞吃蚱蜢一样， 你只管增多如蚱蜢， 加添像蝗虫，
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里，火必烧灭你； 刀必杀戮你， 吞灭你如同蝻子。 任你加增人数多如蝻子， 多如蝗虫吧！
verses.textEnNiv: There the fire will consume you; the sword will cut you down— they will devour you like a swarm of locusts. Multiply like grasshoppers, multiply like locusts!
verses.textEnEsv: There will the fire devour you; the sword will cut you off. It will devour you like the locust. Multiply yourselves like the locust; multiply like the grasshopper!
verses.textEnNkjv: There the fire will devour you, The sword will cut you off; It will eat you up like a locust. Make yourself many—like the locust! Make yourself many— like the swarming locusts!
verses.textEnNlt: But the fire will devour you; the sword will cut you down. The enemy will consume you like locusts, devouring everything they see. There will be no escape, even if you multiply like swarming locusts.
verses.textEnNasb: There fire will consume you, The sword will cut you down; It will consume you as the creeping locust consumes a crop. Multiply yourself like the creeping locust, Multiply yourself like the migratory locust.
verses.textEn: There the fire will consume you; the sword will cut you down— they will devour you like a swarm of locusts. Multiply like grasshoppers, multiply like locusts!

verses.textZh: 你增加了你的商人， 多过天上的星辰。 蚱蜢退了壳，就飞去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你增加了你的商人， 多过天上的星辰。 蚱蜢退了壳，就飞去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你增添商贾，多过天上的星； 蝻子吃尽而去。
verses.textEnNiv: You have increased the number of your merchants till they are more numerous than the stars in the sky, but like locusts they strip the land and then fly away.
verses.textEnEsv: You increased your merchants more than the stars of the heavens. The locust spreads its wings and flies away.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have multiplied your merchants more than the stars of heaven. The locust plunders and flies away.
verses.textEnNlt: Your merchants have multiplied until they outnumber the stars. But like a swarm of locusts, they strip the land and fly away.
verses.textEnNasb: You have made your traders more numerous than the stars of heaven— The creeping locust sheds its skin and flies away.
verses.textEn: You have increased the number of your merchants till they are more numerous than the stars in the sky, but like locusts they strip the land and then fly away.

verses.textZh: 你的领袖多如蝗虫， 你的军长像一群群的蚂蚱； 天凉的时候，停留在篱笆上； 太阳一出，就都飞走了； 没有人知道牠们在甚么地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的领袖多如蝗虫， 你的军长像一群群的蚂蚱； 天凉的时候，停留在篱笆上； 太阳一出，就都飞走了； 没有人知道牠们在甚么地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的首领多如蝗虫； 你的军长仿佛成群的蚂蚱， 天凉的时候齐落在篱笆上， 日头一出便都飞去， 人不知道落在何处。
verses.textEnNiv: Your guards are like locusts, your officials like swarms of locusts that settle in the walls on a cold day— but when the sun appears they fly away, and no one knows where.
verses.textEnEsv: Your princes are like grasshoppers, your scribes like clouds of locusts settling on the fences in a day of cold— when the sun rises, they fly away; no one knows where they are.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your commanders are like swarming locusts, And your generals like great grasshoppers, Which camp in the hedges on a cold day; When the sun rises they flee away, And the place where they are is not known.
verses.textEnNlt: Your guards and officials are also like swarming locusts that crowd together in the hedges on a cold day. But like locusts that fly away when the sun comes up, all of them will fly away and disappear.
verses.textEnNasb: Your courtiers are like the migratory locust. Your officials are like a swarm of locusts Settling in the stone shelters on a cold day. The sun rises and they flee, And the place where they are is not known.
verses.textEn: Your guards are like locusts, your officials like swarms of locusts that settle in the walls on a cold day— but when the sun appears they fly away, and no one knows where.

verses.textZh: 亚述王啊！你的牧人睡觉， 你的贵族安歇， 你的子民分散在各山上， 没有人招聚他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述王啊！你的牧人睡觉， 你的贵族安歇， 你的子民分散在各山上， 没有人招聚他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述王啊，你的牧人睡觉； 你的贵胄安歇； 你的人民散在山间，无人招聚。
verses.textEnNiv: King of Assyria, your shepherds slumber; your nobles lie down to rest. Your people are scattered on the mountains with no one to gather them.
verses.textEnEsv: Your shepherds are asleep, O king of Assyria; your nobles slumber. Your people are scattered on the mountains with none to gather them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria; Your nobles rest inthedust. Your people are scattered on the mountains, And no one gathers them.
verses.textEnNlt: Your shepherds are asleep, O Assyrian king; your princes lie dead in the dust. Your people are scattered across the mountains with no one to gather them together.
verses.textEnNasb: Your shepherds are sleeping, O king of Assyria; Your officers are lying down. Your people are scattered on the mountains And there is no one to gather them.
verses.textEn: King of Assyria, your shepherds slumber; your nobles lie down to rest. Your people are scattered on the mountains with no one to gather them.

verses.textZh: 你的创伤无法医治； 你受的打击非常严重。 听见你这消息的， 都必向你鼓掌； 因为你不断行恶， 谁没有受过害呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的创伤无法医治； 你受的打击非常严重。 听见你这消息的， 都必向你鼓掌； 因为你不断行恶， 谁没有受过害呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你的损伤无法医治； 你的伤痕极其重大。 凡听你信息的必都因此向你拍掌。 你所行的恶谁没有时常遭遇呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Nothing can heal you; your wound is fatal. All who hear the news about you clap their hands at your fall, for who has not felt your endless cruelty?
verses.textEnEsv: There is no easing your hurt; your wound is grievous. All who hear the news about you clap their hands over you. For upon whom has not come your unceasing evil?
verses.textEnNkjv: Your injury has no healing, Your wound is severe. All who hear news of you Will clap their hands over you, For upon whom has not your wickedness passed continually?
verses.textEnNlt: There is no healing for your wound; your injury is fatal. All who hear of your destruction will clap their hands for joy. Where can anyone be found who has not suffered from your continual cruelty?
verses.textEnNasb: There is no relief for your collapse, Your wound is incurable. All who hear about you Will clap their hands over you, For upon whom has your evil not come continually?
verses.textEn: Nothing can heal you; your wound is fatal. All who hear the news about you clap their hands at your fall, for who has not felt your endless cruelty?
